changes.title: API Gateway: Feature (November 10, 2026)
changes.detail: TLS 1.3 for connections to backends TLS 1.3 is now enabled on connections from API Gateway gateways to backend services. When a backend supports TLS 1.3, the gateway uses TLS 1.3.

changes.title: Google Kubernetes Engine: Change (November 10, 2026)
changes.detail: (2026-R47) Version updates GKE cluster versions have been updated. New versions available for upgrades and new clusters. The following versions are now available for new GKE clusters, and for manual control plane upgrades and node upgrades for existing clusters. For more information about versioning and upgrades, see GKE versioning and support and About GKE cluster upgrades .

changes.title: Google Kubernetes Engine: Rapid channel (November 10, 2026)
changes.detail: Note : Your clusters might not have these versions available. Rollouts are already in progress when we publish the release notes, and can take multiple days to complete across all Google Cloud zones. Version 1.37.1-gke.2097000 is now the default version for cluster creation in the Rapid channel. changes.title: Google Kubernetes Engine: Security (November 10, 2026)
changes.detail: (2026-R47) Security updates This release includes new GKE versions that use updated Container-Optimized OS images. These updated images are cumulative, incorporating security fixes from all Container-Optimized OS versions released since the previous GKE release. To identify the specific vulnerabilities that were resolved in each updated Container-Optimized OS image, see the Security release notes for that image.
